home.title: Welcome to my portfolio
home.description: I am a development student at the University of Lorraine, passionate about creating modern web experiences. With solid proficiency in React, TypeScript, and backend technologies such as NestJS and MySQL, I design intuitive, high-performing, and maintainable interfaces. My goal: to combine performance, aesthetics, and accessibility to provide the best possible user experience. I also have a passion for drawing. You can view some of my work on the dedicated page.

skills.title: Technical Skills
skills.paragraph: I am fluent in French and have a good command of English, which I strengthened through stays in the Netherlands and Finland. I also learned some basic German in high school. Passionate about drawing, this practice fuels my creativity and enhances my artistic sensitivity in my projects.

langDescriptions.java: Experience with OOP and data structures.
langDescriptions.c: Basic understanding of memory and pointers.
langDescriptions.dart: Programming language mainly used with Flutter.

techDescriptions.git: Efficient version control solo or in a team.

projects.title: My Projects & Professional Experience

portfolio.title: Interactive Portfolio
portfolio.description: An intuitive and elegant portfolio designed to showcase the work of a graphic designer or artist. The site allows users to comment on, like, and view artworks. Artists can publish and manage their creations, while an admin can manage user accounts and comments.

focusly.title: Focusly
focusly.description: School project: task management site with many features such as task creation and management, work phase initiation, and progress tracking via a growing tree on the homepage.

postar.title: Post-AR
postar.description: Modern and responsive interface for managing postcards, developed in partnership with Erasmus schools in the Netherlands and Spain. Only the front-end part is available here.

cyber.title: Cybersecurity Course Platform
cyber.description: Professional project in progress as part of my Erasmus internship in Finland, for the company Bittiguru Oy. The site allows the company to create, manage, and sell cybersecurity courses to individuals.

projects.mytilimer: Summer job: immersion in the professional world, teamwork, and compliance with production standards.

erasmus.description: Web development internship (React and NestJS), as part of an Erasmus program with the IUT of Metz (B2 - Computer Science, PT RA - FI track).
